statement: You are given a string brackets made only of the characters '{' and '}'.
One reversal turns a single '{' into '}' or a single '}' into '{'. The string is balanced when every '{' can be paired with a later '}' and no bracket is left unpaired, as in "{{}}{}".
Return the minimum number of reversals that makes brackets balanced. If no number of reversals can balance it, return −1.

examples.explanation: After cancelling the matched pairs, one unmatched '}' and three unmatched '{' remain. The '}' needs one reversal and the three '{' need two, for 3 in total.
Reversing the last two brackets gives "{{}}", which is balanced, so 2 reversals are enough.
Three brackets can never all be paired, whatever is reversed, so the answer is −1.
